publication.title: The Foundations of General Relativity: A Source–Readout Reconstruction of Einstein’s 1916 Theory
publication.headline: Recover Einstein’s complete chain.
publication.description: Calibrated measurements recover geometry. Compatible comparison recovers curvature. The same realization carries gravity, matter and the observations that test them. Follow the full source–readout reconstruction of Einstein’s 1916 theory.
publication.subtitle: Calibrated measurements recover geometry. Compatible comparison recovers curvature. The same realization carries gravity, matter and the observations that test them. Follow the full source–readout reconstruction of Einstein’s 1916 theory.
publication.author: Jeremy Rodgers

chapters.title: Recover the complete gravitational chain
chapters.description: Shadow Theory makes the path from local measurements to gravitational dynamics explicit. This edition follows the full construction: the supporting preparation, the geometric and matter realization, the readouts, and the operations that connect them.

chapters.title: Put matter on the same realization
